race.description: John Higgins Memorial Final Ms Pace (L)
race.comment: AMERICAN BLAZE NZ (4) was an impressive winner last start over 2100m at Bunbury, getting home by 4 metres. The one to beat from an ideal draw. MAJOR DISCO (1) is looking for black-type success after taking out a much weaker race at his latest appearance over 2130m at this track, scoring by 2.25 metres. Ideally drawn and can play a big role. CURADH (12) could only manage fifth last start over 2130m at this track, beaten 9 metres. Looms as a serious challenger. FROM TIGERLAND (6) comes here fresh from a third a week ago over 2130m at this track, beaten 7 metres. Sure to prove hard to beat again.
